The '''''Commerce''''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] that was used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. In [[403 BBY]], the vessel disappeared while attempting to make an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] scan of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], in the [[Luire system]].
